description: Elections Commission - A. P. P. E. Jayasekera and R. L. Jayawardena Municipal Council has vacated his Office of member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peremuna - H. S. K. B. Meegalla of the Mawathagama Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his Office of member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of local government bodies (Kurunegala Municipal Council and Mawathagama Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about candidate status and vacancies.
